messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-INC-8791) — Severity: P1 — rwd-gpu-23 (us-west-2a). Reason: kernel panic + kubelet NotReady. Paging eng-oncall. https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-INC-8791 :rotating_light:

maria: acked on PD. jumping in. trying to ssh to rwd-gpu-23...

aj: can you paste the PD payload? need node name/pod list to start mitigation.

maria: payload snippets:
- host: rwd-gpu-23
- az: us-west-2a
- msg: kernel panic - CPU 0: Oops: Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
- kubelet: status NotReady, lastHeartbeat: 45s ago

maria: ssh connection timed out. ping fails. console shows machine unreachable. I can pull last kube events though.

aj: ok — do a quick kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces | grep rwd-gpu-23 to see impacted pods. if control plane still reachable, cordon + drain as needed.

maria: running commands from control plane:
```
$ kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces | grep rwd-gpu-23
kube-system   nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset-abcde   1/1   Running   rwd-gpu-23
prod         model-serving-frontend-5f7c8           0/2   CrashLoopBackOff   rwd-gpu-23
custA        custA-dedicated-pod-1                   0/1   Evicted             rwd-gpu-23
analytics    batch-embedder-0                       0/1   Error               rwd-gpu-23
```

maria: cordoning node now:
```
$ kubectl cordon rwd-gpu-23
node/rwd-gpu-23 cordoned
```

junior-note: drain might take a while because of long-running GPU jobs; suggest --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data and set grace-period to 60s for emergency.

aj: agreed. do: `kubectl drain rwd-gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --force`

maria: running drain...
```
$ kubectl drain rwd-gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --force
Warning: ignoring DaemonSet-managed Pods: kube-system/nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset-abcde
evicting pod prod/model-serving-frontend-5f7c8
evicting pod custA/custA-dedicated-pod-1
evicting pod analytics/batch-embedder-0
...
node/rwd-gpu-23 evicted and marked unschedulable
```

maria: drain succeeded from control plane. kubelet still NotReady though — likely host is dead.

aj: good. reroute traffic for frontend and any customer routes pinned to that node. update routing rules and scale up replacements.

elainesuggestion (elaine): spinning up spare GPU instance pool now (dedicated reserve). tagging any cust-dedicated pods for immediate reschedule.

devops-bot: Provision request submitted: aws ASG launch rwd-gpu-spare-1 (type p4dn) — request id prov-4421. ETA ~8m.

maria: customer impact: I checked our alerting — we have 2 active customer errors linked: custA dashboards show 5xx spikes, latency increase for model-serving for ~2% of traffic. Not a global outage but high-severity for affected customers. Notifying Customer Success.

aj: ping @oncall-sales-ops? we should create a brief incident note to send to CS with impacted customer list and ETA.

maria: created quick incident note in ops docs and pinged @cs-team.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: PD-INC-8791 escalated to next level (sam) after 10m without resolution.

sam: joining. thanks — what's the state of the host console? any serial logs?

maria: console log excerpt (recent):
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU 0000:01:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568901] kernel: general protection fault: 0000 [#1] SMP
[ 1234.569012] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
Call Trace:\n [<ffffffff81134b6c>] panic+0x19c/0x2b0
 [<ffffffff810f7e3a>] do_exit+0x...
```

sam: looks like hardware fault (GPU dropped). we should file ticket to infra and mark node for replacement. set metadata tag 'hw-fault:gpu' on node.

maria: tagging node in inventory and infra ticket created: INFRA-1147. attaching console logs.

aj: question: do we need to run mass cache invalidation? some requests might have partial KV cache pointing to that host.

emergency-action (maria): flushed prefix cache for model-serving route and forced re-replica.

maria: customer-facing note drafted: acknowledging degraded service for CustA and batch analytics jobs. ETA for replacement ~20–40m. CS to send targeted notice.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgment by maria recorded at 1912350050. escalation to sam at 1912350610.

elaine: if spares are healthy, we should schedule a canary deploy of model-serving on new node then scale. avoiding immediate full traffic cutover.

sam: agree. once new node provisioned, validate CUDA drivers, NVIDIA kernel modules, kubelet registration. run smoke test with small model traces.

devops-bot: Provision complete: rwd-gpu-spare-1 registered as rwd-gpu-45, kubelet Ready at 1912350400.

maria: verifying drivers on new host:
```
$ ssh rwd-gpu-45 lspci | grep NVIDIA
01:00.0 3D controller: NVIDIA Corporation Device
$ nvidia-smi -L
GPU 0: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (UUID: GPU-XXXX)
```

maria: scheduling canary pods for model-serving on rwd-gpu-45.

aj: after smoke success, shift traffic using weight-based routing in the service mesh — move 10% -> 50% -> 100%, monitor errors.

maria: canary successful. no OOMs, latency within SLO. shifting 10% now. monitoring dashboards.

sam: good job. once at 100%, drain stays complete, we can decommission rwd-gpu-23 and kick off RMA.

maria: final status update: node rwd-gpu-23 experienced kernel panic (hw-fault related to GPU). node cordoned and drained. replacement spun up rwd-gpu-45. traffic migrated. Impact: CustA experienced degraded availability and batch analytics jobs failed; small percentage (~2%) of production inference requests saw 5xx spikes for ~12 minutes. CS notified. INFRA ticket INFRA-1147 opened for RMA. Postmortem in #postmortems scheduled EOD. Action items:
- infra to RMA GPU/host (INFRA-1147)
- add node-level hardware health checks to avoid silent GPU drop (owner: eng-ml)
- improve automated rebalancing for long-running GPU jobs (owner: eng-platform)
- verify cache eviction/routing playbook (owner: devex)

sam: handing off to daytime oncall (elaine) for follow-ups. I will join postmortem.

elaines: ack. taking ownership. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: resolving PD incident for now, marking incident resolved in timeline once INFRA confirms RMA started. closing thread here, keeping logs attached to INFRA ticket.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-8791 resolved by maria at 1912351500.
